formulas.name: InstallmentCount
formulas.expression:
IF( ISBLANK({!$Record.EndDate}), /* Open Schedule Logic */ CASE(TEXT({!$Record.TransactionPeriod}), "Monthly", FLOOR( 12 / BLANKVALUE({!$Record.TransactionInterval}, 1) ), "Yearly", FLOOR( 1 / BLANKVALUE({!$Record.TransactionInterval}, 1) ), "Weekly", FLOOR( 52 / BLANKVALUE({!$Record.TransactionInterval}, 1) ), "Daily", FLOOR( 365 / BLANKVALUE({!$Record.TransactionInterval}, 1) ), 1 ), /* Fixed Schedule Logic: a populated End Date means Fixed. */ IF( ISBLANK({!$Record.EndDate}), 0, IF( {!$Record.StartDate} > {!$Record.EndDate}, 0, CASE(TEXT({!$Record.TransactionPeriod}), "Daily", FLOOR( ({!$Record.EndDate} - {!$Record.StartDate}) / BLANKVALUE({!$Record.TransactionInterval}, 1) ) + 1,
"Weekly", FLOOR( ({!$Record.EndDate} - {!$Record.StartDate}) / (7 * BLANKVALUE({!$Record.TransactionInterval}, 1)) ) + 1,
"Monthly", FLOOR( ( ((YEAR({!$Record.EndDate}) - YEAR({!$Record.StartDate})) * 12) + (MONTH({!$Record.EndDate}) - MONTH({!$Record.StartDate})) - IF(DAY({!$Record.EndDate}) < DAY({!$Record.StartDate}), 1, 0) ) / BLANKVALUE({!$Record.TransactionInterval}, 1) ) + 1,
"Yearly", FLOOR( ( ((YEAR({!$Record.EndDate}) - YEAR({!$Record.StartDate})) * 12) + (MONTH({!$Record.EndDate}) - MONTH({!$Record.StartDate})) - IF(DAY({!$Record.EndDate}) < DAY({!$Record.StartDate}), 1, 0) ) / (12 * BLANKVALUE({!$Record.TransactionInterval}, 1)) ) + 1, 1 ) ) ) )

formulas.name: TrueStartDate
formulas.expression: IF( DAY({!$Record.StartDate}) <= VALUE(TEXT({!$Record.TransactionDay})), {!$Record.StartDate} - DAY({!$Record.StartDate}) + VALUE(TEXT({!$Record.TransactionDay})), ADDMONTHS({!$Record.StartDate} - DAY({!$Record.StartDate}) + VALUE(TEXT({!$Record.TransactionDay})), 1) )
